reason: Evidence from the README and repository layout indicates the plugin’s primary purpose is a user-facing desktop-style mascot interface in the DeepSeek Harness web client, with a right-corner Live2D character, drag/click interactions, character and costume switching, and interactive tips. The code shape (client entry plus static asset route) supports this UI-focused role rather than automation, orchestration, or external service integration, so risk is limited to front-end script behavior and local state persistence.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 端，在界面中加载 Morfonica Live2D 桌面宠物，支持拖拽、角色与换装切换，并提供点击和互动操作。
summaries.en: This plugin is for the DeepSeek Harness web client, adding a Morfonica Live2D desktop pet with draggable placement, character and costume switching, and interactive actions.

capabilities: Injects a client-side web module into DeepSeek Harness.
Renders an on-page Live2D mascot widget with drag and click interaction.
Loads bundled Live2D runtime and model assets from plugin-provided files.
Provides UI for character switching, costume switching, and mascot actions.
Persists display and position state in browser localStorage keys.
